results.name: Invoice is the only page of the Sales group and starts with generic content and the right totals
totals follow every edit and roll: the new figure slides in from below when it grows and from above when it shrinks
number fields count what is typed and tidy up on blur: clamps, whole quantities, cents
add line: height eases open, focus goes to the new description, defaults are 1 × 0.00; remove: focus goes to Add line item and lines renumber
saving needs a description on every line: the message is announced and focus goes to the empty one
save draft: busy spinner, then Saved with a check; the draft is stored; editing returns the button to Save draft
the saved draft comes back after a reload; unsaved edits do not
header, parties, dates, note and tax are editable and stay in sync
keyboard: Tab walks description, quantity, rate and remove; Enter in a field does not add or submit
responsive: wide, narrow and phone layouts follow the width of the panel; no horizontal overflow
dark theme uses the dark palette
reduced motion: lines and figures swap without lingering copies
touch: add, edit and save work on a phone
nothing leaves localhost and the source has no remote calls
